data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/config-writes.md (silent). Sources A1's plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf (in-plugin filesystem, always available). Writes commands.* keys per detected STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND. Multi-template projects union per A0 multi-valued schema. Append via normalize-then-write helper (split on ';', dedupe, rejoin) to prevent semicolon corruption.
**Why**: Strata's Make targets must shadow generic defaults silently; A1 owns the canonical values.
**Scope**:
- IN: Sub-file with the silent write logic; normalize-then-write helper; multi-template union; idempotent re-run (zero diff on second invocation).
- OUT: Defining the values themselves (A1 owns); arch-enforcement appends (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, on a Strata-detected project the commands.* keys exactly match strata-config-defaults.conf for the detected variant ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, multi-template projects emit unioned values without duplicates and without semicolon corruption ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, idempotent re-run produces zero diff ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, normalize-then-write helper preserves user-set non-Strata values ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for normalize-then-write and union behavior

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Semicolon normalization must round-trip
- [Maintainability] Sub-file Reads the shared defaults file directly — do not duplicate values

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an onboarding consumer, config-writes.md silently writes commands.* from A1's shared defaults
